Messages.Author: Otso
Messages.Body:
I managed to win the Archipelago Jones 2015 tournament held in the beautiful Gothenburg archipelago - thanks for the weekend, Stefan! I don't know if the tournament was sanctioned as the event calendar is down and so on and so forth, I just wanted to claim my 15 minutes of fame with this sneak bleed junk.

Archipelago Jones 2015
Gothenburg, Sweden
12.12.2015
15 players
3R+F

Deck Name: Nergal Dream Team
Author: Otso Saariluoma
Description:
Nergal s&b with some Infernal Servitors and Dream Worlds to spread out the bleeds. In one of the prelims Nergal was the sixth vampire down my crypt, in the other two Nergal was rushed to torpor and graverobbed. I managed to squeeze out a GW in one of the games nevertheless and got to the finals to race against Adam's Kiasyd bleed around the table. In the heads-up against Kim's wallish !Gangrel I managed to get just enough stealth to win the finals. MVP cards of the tournament were: Veneficti, Learjet, Infernal Servitors and ADV-Nergal's special.
